siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of L'Oustau de Baumanière
siblings.summary: Eight character-driven hotels within an 11-minute taxi of L'Oustau de Baumanière — Relais & Châteaux, 17th-c palais, 18th-c mas, and a Provençal hamlet — ranked by fit, not price.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of L'Oustau de Baumanière
siblings.summary: Half- and full-day plans around L'Oustau de Baumanière: the on-foot Les Baux cluster, Saint-Rémy on Wednesday, Arles on Saturday, Alpilles trails, AOP olive mills, biodynamic wine domains.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of L'Oustau de Baumanière
siblings.summary: The Alpilles are a tech-conference desert. Within 30 km of L'Oustau de Baumanière the only dedicated IT events are CIP-PACA's monthly Avignon afterworks and Avignon Université's LIA research seminars.
